messages:
Nadia (AE): PillarBank is ready to start a POC to move off CompetitorY. They want near-drop-in behavior for their existing customer-facing chat and an answer on cost delta. Can we assemble a quick onramp checklist?
Ravi (Solutions): I'll take lead on the compatibility shim. First pass: map request/response fields, then handle streaming frame semantics and stop token differences.
Theo (Presales): They have 95 golden prompts and a regression SLA: no more than 8% functional variance across the set. Need an eval harness + a metric definition (exact vs semantic match).
Lena (Security): PillarBank's GRC team will request a filled security questionnaire and evidence for data-in-transit and at-rest encryption. Also ask: do we support customer-managed keys in EU regions?
ComplianceBot: Checklist: SOC2 yes, ISO27001 yes, customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated and Private, audit logs exportable. Attach DPA for signature.
Marco (SRE): Infra constraints: they require data residency in eu-central-1 and IP whitelisting. I can spin up a dedicated dev pool there. Will need a short-lived creds flow and SIEM forwarding.
Ravi (Solutions): Technical wrinkle: CompetitorY's API returns a top-level `choices` array with `logprobs` and `finish_reason` in-stream frames. Our API streams raw deltas without `logprobs`. I can implement a shim that synthesizes `finish_reason` and embeds approximated `logprob` placeholders so their existing client doesn't choke. Example pseudocode: 
```
# stream shim
for chunk in our_stream:
  if chunk.type == "content":
    yield {"delta": chunk.text}
  if chunk.is_end:
    yield {"finish_reason": map_reason(chunk)}
```

Theo (Presales): Good. Also watch tokenization: CompetitorY uses a legacy UTF-8 split that merges some ligatures. We should normalize inputs: NFC normalize + collapse repeated whitespace. That fixed parity issues previously.
Lena (Security): One more: PillarBank flagged requirement for FIPS-certified crypto for any EU production. Our Hosted offering doesn't guarantee FIPS by default. We'll need to confirm whether the POC can proceed on Dedicated or Private.
Nadia (AE): Commercial note: they're price-sensitive. CompetitorY has a blended per-request + per-token model with volume discounts. PillarBank asked for an apples-to-apples 30-day cost estimate assuming their historical traffic.
Theo (Presales): I'll build a cost model. Need 1) avg tokens per request, 2) requests per minute peaks, 3) percent of streaming calls. Can you get those from PillarBank?
Nadia (AE): I'll ask them to drop the CSV in the secure share.
Marco (SRE): Ops for fallback: propose a route rule: if semantic_match_rate < 0.9 for 10m, switch traffic to CompetitorY via proxy until anomalies resolve. Emit trace header `x-compat-fallback`. Need a Console toggle for manual override.
Ravi (Solutions): For semantic matching I'll compute embeddings and use cosine similarity with a 0.82 threshold, plus a token-level diff for exact-match cases. We'll run both.
Lena (Security): Data retention question: PillarBank insists on 7-day request retention for POC logs, ability to purge on demand. Hosted default is 30 days. We'll document what can be shortened with contractual Addendum.
ComplianceBot: Data subject requests and purge flows: Supported for Dedicated/Private; Hosted can be adjusted with enterprise contract. Provide DSR runbook.
Theo (Presales): Timeline: I can generate the eval harness and cost slides in 4 business days if I get the traffic CSV and golden prompts by EOD.
Marco (SRE): EU dev pool and IP allowlist ready in 2 business days. I can give temporary creds in Vault and a SIEM endpoint.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll deliver the compatibility shim (obridge-compat:v1.1) and a small API adaptor that translates `stop_sequences` -> `stop` semantics, plus a streaming meta reinsertion. ETA 5 days.
Nadia (AE): Who owns the security questionnaire?
Lena (Security): I'll own the answers but need Kevin from Customer Eng to fill architecture/dataflow specifics. We should track open items: FIPS requirement, KMS proof, retention TTLs.
Nadia (AE): PillarBank also asked for a short demo showing identical outputs for 10 canonical prompts. Can we stage that?
Theo (Presales): Yes — once harness is loaded. We'll run both backends and present side-by-side diffs with annotations (token diffs, semantic score, experimental annotations).
Marco (SRE): One potential blocker: CompetitorY's client uses a custom SSE parser that expects `event: token` frames. Our streaming uses chunked JSON; the shim will emit `event` frames but latency might add ~20ms per stream. Call that out in the perf slide.
Ravi (Solutions): Minor note: some punctuation placement differed on examples with quotes and em-dashes. Adding punctuation-aware normalization to the proxy fixed the biggest cases.
Lena (Security): Also confirm: are there SOC reports we can share under NDA? ComplianceBot already flagged SOC2 and ISO certificates. I'll request the PDFs from Docs team.
Nadia (AE): Action items recap: 1) Ravi: compatibility shim + stream adapter (5d). 2) Theo: eval harness + cost model (4d). 3) Marco: EU dev pool + creds (2d). 4) Lena: security questionnaire (need Kevin input). 5) Nadia: collect traffic CSV and golden prompts from PillarBank. Aim to present initial POC in 10 business days.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll push a quick demo branch and post the run command here when ready.
Theo (Presales): If anyone wants my cost template, ping me.
Nadia (AE): Thanks team — I'll set a recurring check-in twice weekly until we finish. :calendar:
